fact: The World Bank implementation status report archived on 22 October 2025 records the indicator 'Facilities with DHIS-2 implementation (DHIS-2 data entry at the facility level)' at 84% on 30 June 2025, up from 69% on 31 December 2024 and past the end target of 65%, with the comment that some health facilities use DHIS-2 directly and others track data on paper and submit them immediately.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Djibouti Health System Strengthening (P178033), Seq No: 7
